easyPrerequisites: Kaya has two or more loyalty counters on it.
description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate The Hive by paying {5} and tapping it, creating at least four artifact tokens due to Kaya, Geist Hunter and Elspeth, Storm Slayer.
Activate Clock of Omens twice by tapping four artifact tokens, untapping Chromatic Orrery and The Hive.
Repeat.
